'''Lana Corrs''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[Mos Ila]], she asked a fellow Imperial to retrieve a special power generator from the local [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]].
